steps.title: Cru shows things on its screen
steps.body: Cru can now put a live panel on its screen while you talk: a list, a status board, steps, a comparison. It changes as the conversation goes and stays until you close it or Cru clears it.

steps.title: Kid mode
steps.body: Set a PIN in Settings, Voice assistant, Kid mode, then start it there, from the tray, or by asking Cru. The PC goes full screen and locked, and a kid Cru becomes your child's friend: learning games for letters, matching, counting and the world, approved YouTube channels, stories and chat, all kid-safe. It asks your phone before anything new, tracks progress for you by area, and ends only with the PIN or from your own device.
